about.title: What this does
about.body: disalytics reads a match demo and lets you review it: the players on the map, the round on the timeline, and every kill, grenade and buy in its place. Everything happens on this device — no demo is ever uploaded. A demo you have opened once opens again straight away, out of this device's own cache. The point is to compress a forty-minute match into a review of about ten.

keyboard.title: Keyboard
keyboard.note: Keys do nothing while you are typing in a field, and the round timeline reads the arrow keys itself while it has focus.

shortcut.clearSelection: Clear the selected player, or close this sheet

legend.title: On the plate
legend.player: A player, in their side's colour. The needle is where they are looking, and it grows longer while they are scoped in.
legend.selected: The player you have selected. They also get the cone of what they can see.
legend.hit: A player who has just been hit. It fades over match time, so scrubbing back through the hit shows it again.
legend.blinded: A player under a flash, with what is left of it sweeping away. A blinded player is not looking anywhere, so the needle goes.
legend.objective: Planting or defusing, filling as it goes.
legend.dead: A player who died, left where they fell.
legend.audible: How far a player can be heard from while they are making noise. Off until you switch it on in settings.
legend.trajectory: A grenade in the air, and the path it took to get there.
legend.he: the blast, over about as quickly as it is in the game.
legend.flash: the bang. What lasts is on the players it caught, not on the ground.
legend.smoke: the cloud, with a ring counting down what is left of it.
legend.fire: the fire, counted down by the same ring.
legend.decoy: the lie, pulsing where it was thrown.
legend.kill: A kill you are pointing at in the feed: a ring where the shot came from, a disc where the player fell.
